headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 7, 2026**
article:
The Kansas City Royals handed the Philadelphia Phillies a historic 15-1 loss, while the New York Yankees took down the Tampa Bay Rays 5-1. The Washington Nationals edged out the Houston Astros 11-12 in a high-scoring game, and the New York Mets secured a thrilling 7-6 victory over the Atlanta Braves.

Injuries continue to plague several teams, with Max Rajcic being placed on the 15-day injured list by the St. Louis Cardinals due to right elbow soreness. Other notable injuries include Martín Pérez (Atlanta Braves), Brandon Woodruff (Milwaukee Brewers), Tomoyuki Sugano (Colorado Rockies), Seth Halvorsen (Colorado Rockies), Matt Gage (San Francisco Giants), Ha-Seong Kim (Atlanta Braves), and Jakob Junis (Texas Rangers).

The New York Mets made a significant move, acquiring right-handed pitcher Matt Seelinger in a trade with the Detroit Tigers. The Mets also received cash in return. Additionally, the Detroit Tigers traded right-handed pitcher Woo-Suk Go to the Minnesota Twins for cash.

top_news.title: **Phillies Suffer Historic Loss to Royals**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals dominated the Philadelphia Phillies 15-1, marking a lopsided victory. Tyler Tolbert led the Royals' offense with 5 hits, including a home run, while Noah Cameron earned the win with 5 strong innings.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Rays 5-1**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 5-1 victory over the Tampa Bay Rays, led by José Caballero's impressive performance at the plate. Caballero hit 2 home runs and drove in 4 runs, while Cam Schlittler pitched 8 strong innings with 8 strikeouts and just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Astros Fall Short in Thrilling 11-12 Loss to Nationals**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals edged out the Houston Astros 11-12 in a high-scoring game, with CJ Abrams leading the Nationals' offense with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. Enyel De Los Santos pitched a strong 1.0 inning in relief, striking out 2 batters without allowing an earned run.

top_news.title: **Mets Edge Braves in Thrilling 7-6 Victory**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets secured a hard-fought win against the Atlanta Braves, outlasting their opponents 7-6. Matt Olson led the Braves' offense with a strong performance, recording 2 hits and 2 home runs.

top_news.title: **Cardinals' Rajcic Lands on 15-Day IL**
top_news.summary: St. Louis Cardinals right-handed pitcher Max Rajcic has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow soreness, effective retroactive to July 4, 2026.

top_news.title: **Mets Acquire RHP Matt Seelinger in Trade**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets have acquired right-handed pitcher Matt Seelinger in a trade with the Detroit Tigers, who received cash in return.
